description: The fatal open with an extended status whose second byte is a printable character. OPEN INPUT reports '92', so L162's IO-STAT1 = '9' test holds and the paragraph renders the first byte verbatim and the second as the three-digit decimal value of its byte: '2' is 50, so the line is FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9050 and not NNNN0092. That distinction is the whole point of the TWO-BYTES-BINARY / TWO-BYTES-ALPHA redefinition at L53-L56, and a translation that simply concatenated the two status characters would pass case09 and fail here.

expectedMessages.text: START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBCUS01C
